seeds: Gate's sealed. Turn around.
Put it away. I will not ask twice.
State your business, and be quick about it.
Ilva vouches for you, so I will hear it. The gate still does not open.
Watch-captain's orders bind me, not my eyes. Say the word and I look east a while.
I don't trade with trouble. Walk on.
Pack's shut. Come back when you've a reason.
Pack's open if your coin is. Draughts, oil, rope.
Rumour, free of charge: the scout came in at dawn bleeding, and nobody has fetched a healer.
Halloran has stood that gate four days without relief. He is scared, not cruel.
Half price on the draughts, for you. Don't tell Halloran I said so.
Don't. Please. I can't even stand.
Water. And a healer, if there's one left in this yard.
My leg's gone. Get me to Halloran at the gate and I'll owe you the rest of it.
Something walked in behind me wearing our colours. The watchword is burned. Tell Halloran.
